principles: Open with a high-impact truthful line tied directly to the package promise.
Use sustained curiosity and longer open loops when the eventual payoff justifies the wait.
Allow setup, examples and breathing room when they reduce cognitive load.
Use larger delayed payoffs rather than forcing a micro-payoff into every section.
The first spoken line must immediately defend against the swipe with a truthful high-impact hook.
Treat the 3-second hook target as a testable production hypothesis, not a universal law.
Aim for a meaningful attention or reward refresh roughly every 4-6 seconds; this is a testable hypothesis.
Every section should deliver progress through proof, novelty, reveal, expectation shift or micro-payoff.
Keep cognitive branching very low and stay on one core idea.
Close open loops quickly and finish with a strong payoff.

hypothesis_notice: Short-form timing targets are starting hypotheses for the Learning Engine to test against actual channel retention; they are not claimed universal physiological laws.
